statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The patient requires further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is medically necessary to document the relationship between the patient's palpitations and any underlying arrhythmia
The diagnoses are I49.9 and R00.2
The denial reason code is PR-204
